observations.title: Synthesized SCHEDULING Heuristic
observations.pattern: Discovered persistent behavioral pattern across 7 historical episodes in scheduling.
observations.hypothesis: User decision policy in scheduling is stable with confidence 0.99.

observations.title: Synthesized COMMUNICATION STYLE Heuristic
observations.pattern: Discovered persistent behavioral pattern across 4 historical episodes in communication_style.
observations.hypothesis: User decision policy in communication_style is stable with confidence 0.97.

observations.title: Hyper-Concise Executive Directive
observations.pattern: User strictly enforces zero preamble, immediate quantitative metric leads, and max 3 bullets.
observations.hypothesis: Executive reads communications primarily on mobile or between rapid context-switches.

observations.title: Investor Exception to Friday Protocol
observations.pattern: User prioritizes investor access above internal focus blocks on Friday afternoons.
observations.hypothesis: Investor relations override standard calendar defenses when scheduled after 2:00 PM.

observations.title: Communication Density Preference
observations.pattern: User consistently rejects conversational fluff and demands metrics-first briefings capped under 150 words with max 3 bullets.
observations.hypothesis: Executive prioritizes cognitive bandwidth over politeness filler.

observations.title: Friday Afternoon Deep Work Sanctity
observations.pattern: User strictly protects Friday afternoons starting at 1:00 PM for uninterrupted focus, declining all internal syncs.
observations.hypothesis: Internal operational meetings must be re-routed to Mon-Thu windows.

mentalModels.title: Executive Communication Standard
mentalModels.belief: Always lead communications with quantitative findings/variance. Omit preamble and warmups. Limit briefings to 3 actionable bullet items.

mentalModels.title: Calendar Routing & Friday Policy
mentalModels.belief: Default: Reject internal meetings on Friday afternoons after 1:00 PM. Exception: Series-A investor calls (e.g. Elena Rostova / Horizon Ventures) are explicitly permitted after 2:00 PM.
exceptions: Elena Rostova & Series-A investor calls permitted on Fridays after 2:00 PM with 15m buffer.

mentalModels.title: Stakeholder Hierarchy & VIP Routing
mentalModels.belief: Elena Rostova (Horizon Ventures) is P0 tier. Investor requests bypass standard calendar queue and require immediate notification.
